changes: Workouts: after “Finish” a summary window opens — time, working sets, total volume, number of exercises, records you broke and the muscles worked. Warm-up sets don’t count toward sets or volume.
The avatar and name in the sidebar no longer disappear on a bad connection: the last known ones are taken from the device and refreshed when the network is back.

Keyboard shortcuts for the computer: press g, then a letter, to open a page (g d Dashboard, g g Goals, g s Skills, g w Workouts, g c Challenges, g l Languages, g k Calendar, g m Milestones, g h Shop, g a Achievements, g t Customization, g o Community). The ? key shows a cheat sheet. They stay quiet while you type in a field, when a window is open and with Ctrl/Cmd/Alt. A checkbox in Global settings turns them off, and that choice follows you to your other devices. No migrations.

Workouts: in an active workout, tapping the grey “previous time” hint fills that set with the weight and reps, and a “Fill from last time” button under the exercise fills all empty sets at once (anything you already typed stays). The hint doesn’t count as a completed set until you tick it.

Skills: a skill can have a category (pick one of yours or type a new one, up to 40 characters), and the “In progress” list splits into collapsible category sections. Works once migration 112 is applied; until then the page looks as before.

Newbie menu: during the first 7 days after sign-up the sidebar shows 6 main sections (Dashboard, Goals, Skills, Workouts, Calendar, Shop) and a “More (N)” button that reveals the rest. “Show all” on the dashboard also opens the menu. Older accounts keep the full menu.

Community: a new “No competition” checkbox sits under the tabs. Turn it on to hide Ranking, Compare, the podium and your place in the profile header; Feed and Friends stay. The choice is remembered and follows you to your other devices together with your other look-and-feel settings. It does not change whether others see you in their ranking. No migrations.

Workouts: routines. During a workout tap “Save as routine” and name it — the set of exercises is remembered. A new “My routines” block on the page has a “Start” button that opens a workout with those exercises and the right number of empty sets, with your previous weights hinted alongside. For now routines are stored on this device; syncing across devices is the next step.

Goals, Challenges, Milestones and Skills (and books): while a list is still loading the page now says “Loading…” instead of “No active goals” / “No active milestones” / “Book list is empty”. On a slow connection a false empty state used to flash for a second. A real empty state only appears after the server answers, and on failure you get an error with a “Try again” button.

Dashboard: on Sundays and Mondays a Weekly summary card appears, with no wall of charts, only what matters: how many metric check-ins you completed, your best day, the metric that improved most compared with last week (when there is enough data), and a field for what you will change next week. The note and the dismissal are stored on this device. Days before your first entry are not counted as misses. No migrations.

Workouts: records right during a workout. Tick a set that beats your best weight, reps at the same weight, estimated 1RM, set volume or time, and a “★ Weight record · 62.5 kg × 8” line appears under it along with a notice. Warm-up sets never count, a tie isn’t a record, and neither is the very first set ever logged for an exercise.

Workouts: a “Start workout” button opens a screen with a stopwatch. Add exercises, enter weight and reps with the “previous time” hint next to them, and tick each set; tap the set number to mark it as warm-up (W), drop set (D) or to failure (F). “Finish” saves everything as one workout; a workout with no completed sets isn’t saved. Closing the tab doesn’t lose it. Works without the new migration — entries are saved the old way.

Goals: next to “Add” there is a new “Templates” button with a catalogue of 16 ready-made goals in groups (sport, health, study, money, home, creative). Pick one and the usual goal form opens pre-filled with the name, category, number of stages and difficulty; tweak what you need, set a deadline and save. A goal you already have is marked “already added”. No migrations.

Skills → Books: a new “Import CSV” button — upload your Goodreads export (My Books → Import and export → Export Library) and the books are added in one go: read books with their date read, “to read” and “currently reading” go to your plans. You see how many books will be added first, and books you already have (by title and author) are skipped. Imported read books give no points. Ratings and page counts are not imported yet. No migrations.

Dashboard: the Charts block now has a year grid, one square per day for the past year. Pick Perfect days (everything due that day done) or a single metric. States are told apart by more than color: done is filled, missed is an outline, a scheduled rest day is a dot, today is dashed, and labels sit below the grid. Tap a day to see its value and notes; arrow keys work too. Days before your first entry are not counted as misses. No migrations.

Shop and Community: while data is still loading, the page now says “Loading…” instead of “Nothing here yet” / “Empty for now”. On a slow connection a false empty state used to flash for a second, as if there were no items or friends. If loading fails you get an error with a “Try again” button, and a real empty state only appears after the answer.

Goals: an active multi-stage goal with a deadline now shows “Need ~N stages a week” under its chips. Once the goal is at least a week old, your pace and an “on track” or “behind” verdict appear next to it; with less history there is no verdict. Simple goals and goals without a deadline show nothing. No migrations.

Skills → Books: a new “Reading goal” card above the list: set how many books you want to read this year and see a progress ring, an “ahead of / behind plan by N books” line, your average pace and monthly bars (by the date a book was marked as read). The goal is kept on this device. No migrations.

Dashboard: next to the streak, every daily metric now shows a habit strength, a smooth score from 0 to 100 percent. A completed day raises it and a miss lowers it, but a single miss after a long streak barely moves it. Metrics without a streak show the score too; it stays hidden until 7 days are counted. Weekly-count and at-most metrics are not scored. No migrations.

Calendar: below the month grid there is an “Export month (.ics)” button — the day plans and goal deadlines of the shown month download as a file that opens in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar and Outlook (all-day events, completed items marked with a check). If the month is empty, the button says so. No migrations.

The “Try again” button on load errors is now also on Home (summary and charts) and in Community (leaderboard, today and categories), not only in Shop, Goals, Skills, Achievements, Milestones and Challenges. Offline, it adds “You are offline — check your connection”. The list of pages available without internet was also refreshed (it had gone stale after the latest builds).
Challenges → custom challenge: under the “Duration, days” field there are now “7 d”, “30 d” and “100 d” buttons for a quick pick; any other number can still be typed. No migrations.

When a page cannot load its data (no connection, server hiccup), the message now has a “Try again” button, so you no longer have to reload the whole page. Offline, it also says “You are offline — check your connection”. Done in Shop, Goals, Skills (and books), Achievements, Milestones and Challenges; in the Shop the old error message disappears after a successful retry.
In the Android app, Workouts gives a short vibration when an entry or a set is saved (nothing changes in the browser). No migrations.

Dashboard: the "Left for today" list now includes plan items — your own unticked ones. An item with a time goes first and shows it; one without a time comes after the daily metrics. Tick an item with one tap right from the list. Goal items stay in the Plans block only for now. No migrations.

In the Android app, Settings has a new “Phone reminders” section: a water reminder (from/to hour and how often) and a workout reminder (time and weekdays). The settings are kept on this phone. The section does not appear in the browser. No migrations.

The sign-in and sign-up page has been refreshed: compact language (EN/RU) and theme (sun/moon) switches at the top, the title with a subtitle "Habits, goals and progress — in one place" next to the flame, icons inside the email and password fields, a soft glow in the chosen theme's colour, and a loading indicator on the sign-in button. Choosing the light or dark theme is still available right on the sign-in page. No migrations.

Dashboard: a new "Left for today" list sits above the daily metrics — what is still undone today at a glance. Tick a yes/no metric with one tap right from the list; number metrics show progress (for example 3 / 8 glasses) and a "Go to field" button. Closer to done means higher up. Limits ("at most N"), "N times a week" and skipped days are left out. Plan items come in the next step. No migrations.

In the Android app: a short vibration when you tap “+” on water (nothing changes in the browser). The groundwork for water and workout reminders is in place; their settings screen comes later. No migrations.

Phone: buttons and tabs that were smaller than 32 px (Shop tabs, Achievements filters, Skills chips, Calendar arrows, the version button) are now at least 32 px, so they are easier to tap. Larger buttons are unchanged. The same now applies to Dashboard, Workouts and Customization. No migrations.
Fixed: in Customization, the “favorite” heart on theme cards stuck out of the card when the name and rarity were long — the row now wraps and the heart stays inside. No migrations.

Phone: buttons and tabs that were smaller than 32 px (Shop tabs, Achievements filters, Skills chips, Calendar arrows, the version button) are now at least 32 px, so they are easier to tap. Larger buttons are unchanged; Dashboard, Workouts and Customization come in a separate pass. No migrations.
Fixed: water logged from two tabs at the same time could lose part of the taps in the day total — writes now take a shared browser lock, so the tabs wait for each other. No migrations.

Dashboard for newcomers: for the first 7 days after sign-up only “Daily metrics” with today’s plan are shown — no profile, charts or widgets, so it is not overwhelming. The rest opens by itself after a week or right away with “Show everything”. Nothing changes for existing users. No migrations.

Shop: reward for finishing a goal. The wish form has a new “For sparks / For a goal” switch: attach a goal you have not finished yet to your wish, and the reward is yours without spending sparks. The card shows “🎯 For a goal”, the goal name and a stage bar (“3 of 5”); once the goal is done a “Claim reward” button appears. If the goal is deleted the wish is not lost: you can bring it back from the archive with a price. Goal rewards are hidden from friends’ wishlists. Needs migration 111 (until then there is no switch and the shop works as before).
Texts: Customization now consistently uses the informal “you” (Russian version mixed “ты” and “вы”), and several hints got shorter — Looks, Themes, Rarity, the intro and “Coming next”. No migrations.

Fixed: when the server answered 503/429 (a temporary failure), an offline write was marked “rejected” and never retried — it now stays in the queue and is sent later. Under the hood: offline autotests cover a 100-entry queue, two tabs and clock changes. No migrations.
Customization → Icon style: a sixth set, “Accent” — two-tone icons: outline in the text color, tint in your theme accent color (changes with the theme). Free, no migrations.

Fixed: on the “How to use” page (and dozens of other windows) swiping made the left menu and the right panel slide in from the sides. While any window is on screen, the drawers no longer open by swipe. No migrations.
Customization → Icon style: a new “Sketch” set — the same icons, but with a slightly wobbly, hand-drawn line. Five sets in total: Outline, Solid, Duotone, Pixels, Sketch. Free, no migrations.

Calendar → History: new “Period summary” card — week, month or year compared with the previous period: average day progress, days at 100%, workout days, plan goals done, and below it what got better and what slipped (arrow and sign, not just colour). The comparison only appears when at least 60% of days were tracked in both periods, otherwise it says “not enough data”; metrics without a goal change neutrally, with no better/worse verdict; skipped days are not counted as missed. There is an “All metrics” table and a switch in “Show”. No migrations.

Achievements: each of the 61 achievements (51 visible and 10 secret) now has its own icon — many used to share one. The glow on legendary badges no longer pulses when motion is turned off (system setting or the site-wide animation switch). Muscle map: untrained muscles are drawn dashed and trained ones with a solid outline, so the difference is visible without relying on colour; the selected muscle is announced to screen readers; the Anatomy, Atlas and Tech modes now look more distinct. No migrations.

Customization → Icon style: instead of thinner/bolder strokes there are now real icon sets with different artwork — Outline (as before), Solid (filled glyphs), Duotone (outline with a soft second-tone fill) and Pixels (8-bit 16×16 grid). The choice applies to every page at once, is remembered and synced across devices; the sets are cached for offline use. The old stroke styles are gone (anyone who picked them is back on Outline). No migrations.

Shop: buying feels livelier — a quick burst of sparks around the "Bought" notice, and on the balance the number blinks and a "−N" floats up showing what you spent. Works in all three views (Goal, Showcase, List), nothing overflows on a phone; animations are off when reduced motion is on. No migrations.

Water is more reliable offline: when there is no connection and the phone shows an outdated day total, a new glass no longer overwrites the previous one — the app uses your latest not-yet-sent entry. The day total and the glass log match once the network is back. No migrations.

Language learning: the word lists are no longer a wide table but tidy rows — word and translation on top, the example in italics below; nothing runs off the screen on a phone, and the trash icon turns red only on hover.
Rewards shop: the first visit now shows one banner (“The Rewards Stall”) instead of two in a row, and in the “Goal” view the balance is a compact line above the goal card.
Rewards shop: the delete button no longer glows red on every card — it turns red only on hover.

Customization: a new block-collapse marker — “Circled arrow” (100 points): an arrow inside a circle that turns to the right when a block is collapsed. Works on the Dashboard and in Workouts. Migration 110 is needed for it to appear in the shop. Also fixed the preview of collapse styles: for a new style it could previously show a plain chevron.
Customization, “Day progress gauge”: two new colored day rings — “Lavender” (lilac to violet, 100) and “Gold” (pale yellow to amber, 150). Needs migration 109.
Customization, “Water animation”: two new water-saved animations — “Spin” (the glass makes a full turn, 100) and “Rise” (the glass floats up from below, 150). Needs migration 108.

Workouts work offline: you can add, edit or delete a set, and create, rename or delete an exercise even without internet — the change shows up in the list right away and is sent to the server by itself once the connection returns (no loss, no duplicates). Daily metrics linked to an exercise are updated the same way. No migrations.
Customization, “Block fold marker”: two new markers — “Diamond” (100) and “Star” (150); filled while a block is open, an outline when folded. Needs migration 107.
Offline: if the phone clock was reset or rolled back, queued records no longer get stuck waiting — they are sent at the first connection. Shop wording fixed to the informal “you”.
Rewards shop: when it is empty you now see a card with an “Add a reward” button instead of a plain line.

Customization: two more non-circular avatar frames — “Ferris wheel” (150 points: a thin rim with twelve colourful cabins) and “Baroque” (250 points: a double golden rim, pearls and four lilies at the cardinal points). They show in the left menu, on the Account page, in Community, on the Dashboard and in the Customization preview. They can be bought once migration 106 is applied in Supabase.
Rewards shop: a “Bought: …” note with a small animation now appears after a purchase.

Rewards shop: a new “Goal” view — a big card for the next reward with a saved-so-far bar and an “≈ N d at your pace” estimate, and a list with progress below. Three views to choose from now — “Goal” (default), “Showcase” and “List”; a view you already picked is kept.

Customization: two new water glass shapes — “Highball” (a tall slim glass with a straw, 100 points) and “Barrel” (a round barrel with hoops, 150 points). The chosen shape is used for the water icon in the header and on the Dashboard. Migration 105 is needed for them to appear in the shop.

When a new version of the app is released, a "A new version is available" note with an "Update" button appears at the bottom of the screen (you can postpone it with "Later"). The phone app also gets a check for the minimum supported version. No migrations.

Customization → “Icon style”: a sixth style — “Duotone”. Closed shapes of icons (circles, the gear, bag, bin, calendar, envelope, trophy…) get a soft tint, while open lines (arrows, plus, charts, check marks) stay a plain stroke. Like the other styles it applies at once on all pages, syncs between devices and is part of “Looks”. Free.

Water works offline: a glass, editing the total and “Undo” are now recorded even without internet — the app accepts the entry locally and sends it when the connection returns (no entry is lost or duplicated). If the day total is unknown and there is no network, a clear message is shown instead of a wrong number. Works in both the Dashboard water window and the header. No migrations.
The water reminder is no longer just dismissable: it has “+ 200 ml”, “+ 1 l” and “+ Custom” buttons right in the banner. Water is saved as usual — with the glass, points and the Undo button.

Customization: more non-circular avatar frames, and a new place for them. “Tyre” (150 points: a tyre with tread) and “Ship wheel” (250 points: a wooden rim with eight handles). The frame ornament (“Laurel wreath”, “Vines”, “Flourish”, “Tyre”, “Ship wheel”) is now also drawn on the Dashboard around the profile avatar, under the day progress arc. The new frames can be bought once migration 104 is applied in Supabase.

Calendar: a “Today” card now sits above the month grid. It shows today’s plans (“Plans: 1 of 5”, the first items with checkmarks) and the nearest goal deadlines over the next two weeks — overdue ones are highlighted. “Open day” opens today’s plan window; when there are no plans the button offers to plan the day. The card does not depend on which month you are browsing and refreshes after you save a day. You can hide it in “Show”.
Offline reading: pages remember the last data they loaded and show it without a connection (lists, charts, settings — whatever you opened before). When you sign out, this data is erased.

Being offline no longer throws you to the sign-in page: if your sign-in token expired while there was no connection, the app keeps your session and opens offline; once the network is back the sign-in refreshes by itself.

Customization → a new “Icon style” section: how ALL icons on all pages look — “Outline” (as before), “Thin”, “Bold”, “Angular” (square ends and sharp corners) or “Double stroke” (an offset translucent copy). The choice applies at once, without a reload, syncs between your devices and is part of “Looks”. All styles are free.

The app now starts without internet: pages and their files are saved on the device when you open them (data is shown from the last saved copy; writing offline comes in the next stage). The browser is asked not to clear the site storage when space runs low. No migrations.

Customization: the first non-circular avatar frames — an ornament around the avatar extends beyond its outline. “Laurel wreath” (250 points, leaf branches with a golden ribbon), “Vines” (150 points, a winding stem with leaves and flowers) and “Flourish” (250 points, a golden ring with scrolls and diamonds). The frames show in the left menu, on the Account page, in Community and in the Customization preview; on the Dashboard they only colour the progress arc for now. They can be bought once migration 103 is applied in Supabase.

Customization: “Looks” are here. Set things up the way you like (theme, avatar frame, gauges, streak flame, water, charts, loading screen) and tap “Save current look” — up to 5 looks with your own names. Then any look can be put on in one tap: everything switches at once and the page reloads. If some items from a look are not available to you yet, they are skipped and you are told so. Looks are saved to your profile and available on your other devices — together with the choice of loading screen, flame and chart settings that used to stay on a single device.

A cloud badge for offline mode appears in the header: it shows there is no connection or how many entries wait to be sent. Tap it for the list; if the server rejected an entry you can retry or discard it.

Clear messages instead of technical ones: when a feature is not connected in the database yet (metric settings, charts, the “For the week” goal horizon, exercise-to-metric links, words, milestones, challenges, workouts), you now see a short “not available yet, try again later” instead of “apply migration NNN in Supabase (SQL editor)”. The migration hint stays in the developer console. No migrations.
Offline mode: body parameter values (weight and others) from the Profile are also saved through the queue — without a connection the entry is sent later.

Offline groundwork: metric check-ins, sets, tick notes and “What did I do today” on the Dashboard are now written through a queue — without a connection the entry is kept on the device and sent when the network is back. No “waiting to sync” indicator yet (coming separately).

Friendly “you” everywhere: in the Russian interface (Dashboard, Goals, Workouts, Shop, Community, Achievements, Calendar, Challenges, Skills, Languages, Milestones, Account, header and onboarding) the remaining formal address forms were replaced with the informal one. Where two people are meant (“you are friends now”) it is left as is. No migrations.

Customization, weekly gauge: two new styles — “Towers” for 100 points (a tall bar every third day) and “Weekend” for 150 points (Saturday and Sunday stand taller than weekdays). Shown in the header and on the Dashboard.

Texts are shorter and addressed to you: Workouts (templates, warm-up, set entry, two-sided exercises), calendar, challenges, shop and app-install hints. If saving the profile fails at sign-up, a calm message replaces the technical migration hint (the detail moved to the console). No migrations.

Customization: the two water sections (“Water animation” and “Water animation (items)”) are now one “Water animation” slot: the basic animations on top and the extra items below. The showcase has a single cell with one “unlocked/total” counter, and inside the slot the counters and the “All · Mine · Shop” switch count both lists together.
Customization, daily gauge: two new ring styles — “Mint” for 100 points (a green-to-turquoise gradient) and “Ember” for 150 points (yellow, orange, red). Shown in the header and on the Dashboard.

Simpler texts: hints in Community and Achievements are shorter and friendlier, and instead of “apply the migration in Supabase” (which ordinary users saw) there is now a short, clear message: in Achievements “badges are saved on this device for now”, in Customization “not available yet, try again later”. The migration hint now lives only in the developer console. No migrations.

Plans on the home page → “Repeating items…”: a created item can now be edited — the ✎ button moves it into the form (title, time, schedule), “Save” writes the change and “Cancel editing” leaves without saving; before you had to delete and re-create it. And on future days a “By schedule on this day” list appears under the table — the repeating items (“every day” and “on chosen weekdays”) that fall on that day; an item can still be ticked only today.

Customization, water animation: two new ones — “Shake” for 100 points (the glass trembles from side to side) and “Drop” for 150 points (the glass drops in from above and lands softly). Play in the header and on the Dashboard.

Customization, water glass style: two new shapes — “Carafe” for 150 points (round, with a narrow neck) and “Teacup” for 100 points (with a handle and a saucer). Shown in the header and on the Dashboard.

Simpler texts: Dashboard hints, the water-goal explanation and the header settings are shorter and friendlier (14 hints: sets plan, how the water goal is calculated from weight and height, chart period, block order, reminders, records and more). Same meaning, less wall of text. No migrations.

Customization, block-collapse marker: two new styles — “Long arrow” for 100 points (an arrow with a stem) and “Ring” for 150 points (empty when a block is open, with a dot when folded). Work on the Dashboard and in Workouts.

Customization → charts → “Markers”: two new free styles for the little pie-chart dots on charts of metrics with set variations — “Ring” (a donut with a hole in the middle) and “Target” (a thin outer ring with a smaller pie inside). Together with “Sticker” and “Neon”, added in parallel, there are now eight styles. The section hint no longer states a count, which kept going stale. Charts pick up the choice the next time the page opens.

The onboarding tour is shorter and addressed to you directly (7 steps, same topics): less text for a newcomer. The tour texts now live in one place and are rolled out to every section by one script, so the copies cannot drift apart. No migrations.

Customization: it is easier to browse and pick inside a section. When you open a section (for example avatar frames or themes) you get an “All · Mine · Shop” switch with counts, search by name and sorting (by rarity, price or name). Items are one list, and the rarity is written on the card itself. They used to be split into collapsible rarity groups — that feed is still available with “Everything in one list”.
Customization, weekly gauge: two new styles — “Peak” for 100 points (seven bars with the summit on Thursday) and “Saw” for 150 points (three ramps in a row). Shown in the header and on the Dashboard.

Customization → Charts → “Point marker”: two new free styles — “Sticker” (a white die-cut border with a shadow, like a sticker) and “Neon” (soft glowing halos and a bright core). There are now six styles; your choice is remembered and charts pick it up when the page opens. No migrations.

Customization, daily gauge: two new ring styles — “Ocean” for 150 points (turquoise, blue, indigo gradient) and “Aurora” for 250 points (northern-lights colours: green, turquoise, violet, pink). Shown in the header and on the Dashboard.

Customization: two new free streak flame looks — “Torch” (a torch with a wooden handle and a wide flame) and “Spark” (a twinkling star with a pulsing core). The “Streak flame” section grew from five to seven looks. The choice shows on the Dashboard from the next load; at 30 and 100 day streak tiers the glow is brighter and sparks appear. No migrations.

Customization: the page is easier to use. Instead of a long feed with tabs there is now a showcase: one cell for each place where an item is visible (themes, avatar frame, gauges, streak flame, water, charts, loading screen). A cell shows what you are wearing now and how much is unlocked. Tap a cell to see the options of that section; the “Back” button (and the phone’s Back) returns to the showcase. The previous feed is available with “Everything in one list”. Next: a single item card and “Looks”.
Vintage Paper theme: the dashed "+" button (for example, adding a language) no longer gets a solid ring on top of its dashed border. No migrations.

Dashboard: when creating a daily metric, “Sets” (reps + variation) is now selected by default and listed first, with “Number” second. The “Number” label no longer uses push-ups as an example (now water, steps), and a hint under the type selector explains the difference. Onboarding also creates “Push-ups” as sets. Existing metrics are unchanged. No migrations.

Customization, water animation: two new ones — “Tilt” for 100 points (the glass tips over like a sip and swings back) and “Flash” for 150 points (the glass flashes with light twice). Play in the header and on the Dashboard.

Customization → charts → “Mini-charts”: the small 7-day chart under a number metric now has a look — “Line” (as before), “Area”, “Bars” or “Dots”. Bars grow from zero so the height never lies; dots have no connecting line; a missed day stays a gap. The chart itself is still switched on by the separate “Mini-charts” toggle. The choice shows the next time the page opens.

Customization, block-collapse marker: two new styles — “Square” for 100 points (filled when a block is open, an outline when folded) and “Burger” for 150 points (three lines when folded, two when open). Work on the Dashboard and in Workouts.

Customization, water glass style: two new shapes — “Beaker” for 150 points (with lab measuring marks) and “Pitcher” for 250 points (round-bellied, with a handle). Shown in the header and on the Dashboard.

New theme “Mint Clinic” (🩺): a light, spotless mint-teal look — mint background, teal accent, small crisp corners, a very light shadow and barely visible mint glints in the background corners. Available right away; pick it in Settings or Customization → Themes. “Simple look” and high contrast remove the glints and shadow. No migrations.

Customization: the “opened/total” counters of the Streak flame, Loading screen, Water animation and other sections showed outdated numbers (for example, 2 instead of 5 for the streak flame). The number is now counted from the real list of variants and grows by itself when a new one is added. Under the hood this is the first step of a bigger tidy-up of the section: all sections are gathered into one list of “slots”.

Customization → “Chart line style”: two new free styles — “Steps” (the value holds until the next measurement, straight corners only — honest for weight and habits) and “Neon glow” (a smooth line with a soft glow); there are now five. Charts pick up the choice the next time the page opens.

New theme “Fresh Grass” (🌱): a light, fresh yellow-green look — lime background, vivid green accent, green shadows and a “grassy” glow along the bottom edge with a pale-yellow glint in a corner. Available right away; pick it in Settings or Customization → Themes. “Simple look” and high contrast remove the glow and shadow. No migrations.

Customization: two new week gauge styles — “Valley” (seven bars in an inverted arch: tallest at the edges, lowest in the middle of the week, 150 points) and “Slope” (stairs going down: the tallest bar on Monday, the shortest on Sunday, 100 points). The “Week view” section grew to eight items. They can be bought once migration 092 is applied in Supabase.

Customization → “Chart type”: two new free looks — “Dots” (just the markers, no connecting line) and “Lollipops” (a thin stem from zero with a dot on top); there are now four. Dots and lollipops have no line styles or forecast, and lollipops start from zero like bars. Charts pick up the choice the next time the page opens.

Customization, daily gauge: two new ring styles — “Thread” for 100 points (a hair-thin, unobtrusive ring) and “Sunset” for 150 points (a ring with a sunset gradient: orange, pink, violet). Shown in the header and on the Dashboard.

Workouts, Exercises tab: the "Variation" field in a set row is no longer clipped on phones — it now sits on its own line under the set, so the "Variation (optional)" hint reads in full. No migrations.

Several accounts on one device (up to 3). A new “Accounts” row under your name in the side menu lets you switch to another account or tap “Add account” — you sign in to a second one and the first stays. The same is on the Account page. When there are several accounts, “Log out” asks which one to log out of, or all at once. The sign-in page shows the accounts already saved here, one tap to continue. Switching reloads the page; each account keeps its own data.

New theme “Ember” (🔥): a dark, warm look — charcoal-brown background, orange accent, soft rounded corners, a warm glow on cards and “embers” along the bottom edge and in a corner of the background. Available right away; pick it in Settings or Customization → Themes. “Simple look” and high contrast remove the glow. No migrations.

Customization, weekly gauge: a new “Teeth” style for 100 points — seven bars, tall and short in turn like the teeth of a comb; each fills from the bottom with that day’s progress. Shown in the header and on the Dashboard.

New theme “Snowfield” (❄️): a light, cool look — frosty blue background, deep blue accent, crisp small corners, cool shadows and pale-blue “ice glints” in the background corners. Available right away; pick it in Settings or Customization → Themes. “Simple look” and high contrast remove the glints and shadow. No migrations.

Vintage Paper theme: card-style buttons and chips (for example, the body-diagram suggestions when creating a metric) no longer have a double jagged border — the theme drew a solid ring on top of an already dashed border. No migrations.

Customization → “Streak flame”: three new free looks for the flame next to your streak — “Fire ring”, “Ember” and “Candle” (five in total). They all grow with your streak: from 7 days, brighter and faster at 30 and 100 days, with sparks from the 30-day step; the animation is switched off by “reduce motion” and the global animation switch. The choice shows on the Dashboard from the next load.

Customization: two new water animations — “Bounce” (the glass hops up and lands with a little spring, 100 points) and “Pulse” (the glass gently “breathes” twice, 150 points). The “Water animation” section grew from five to seven items. They can be bought once migration 089 is applied in Supabase.

Sets of an exercise linked to Workouts now appear “in a column” on the Dashboard, like a regular metric: each row has time, reps and a set “variation”; edit right in the row, add a “+ set” (copies the previous one) or remove it. Everything is saved to Workouts.
Workouts: every set now has an optional “Variation” field (in the entry rows and in the “Details…” window); it shows in the entry text and carries over to the Dashboard. “+ set” copies it too.

New theme “Cherry Blossom” (🌸): a light, delicate pink — milky pink background, raspberry accent, the softest rounded corners, pink shadows and “petal” glows in the background corners. Available right away; pick it in Settings or Customization → Themes. “Simple look” and high contrast remove the glows and shadow. No migrations.

New exercise metric: a "Pick a name by body diagram" button now appears under the Name field — the same diagram as in Workouts (green muscles were worked in the last 4 days; picking a muscle and an exercise fills in the name). The picker code moved to a shared module; Workouts behave as before. No migrations.

Fixed a desktop bug: when you scrolled below the first screen (Page Down, mouse wheel), the page header disappeared. The header now stays on top on every page of the site, and the background covers the whole length of the page.

New theme “Autumn Harvest” (🍂): a warm light autumn day — cream background, rust-amber accent, soft warm shadows and “leaf” glows in the background corners. Available right away; pick it in Settings or Customization → Themes. “Simple look” and high contrast remove the glows and shadow. No migrations.

Workouts: a new “Today” block above the tabs shows what you have done today, with a “+ set” button right in it (copies the last set). The new “Journal” tab lists entries by day, newest first. Tabs now read: Journal · Muscle map · Progress · Exercises (BACKLOG 44.5b, slice 1).

Customization, block collapse: two new marker styles for 100 points each — “Dot” (solid when a block is open, a ring when folded) and “Double arrow”. The chosen style applies on the Dashboard and in Workouts.

Plans on the home page: repeating items. Under “More” there is a new “Repeating items…” button — create an item with a schedule: every day, on chosen weekdays or several times a week (with an optional time). On today, a “Repeating today” list appears under the table: ticking an item puts a regular completed item into the plan; “N times a week” items are offered every day until N is reached for the week. Needs migration 087; without it the block and the button are hidden and Plans work as before.

Customization: debug mode now does something — locked and paid items get a “Try on” button (shown only to an admin with debug mode on, with a banner on top and “Reset try-on”). Try-on works on this device only: nothing is bought, saved on the server or visible to others, and it disappears when the page reloads. No migrations (needs 066 with debug mode).

Calendar: the day plan window has a new “Day summary” button — it opens the same summary as tapping a day in History (shown for days that already have data). The summary opens on top of the window, and your unfinished plans stay as they were.

Calendar: there is a new “Show” row above the month grid — hide what you do not need. On the Calendar tab you can hide plans and goal deadlines; on the History tab, day progress, the week column, month stats, the category chart and the weeks list. The month grid always stays. Your choice is saved to your profile and picked up on other devices.

Admin moved to Vue (BACKLOG 47.5): the /admin/ page is now built like the rest — a users table (name, email, admin badge, registration date; you are marked “(that's you)” and cannot delete yourself), deletion with a confirm dialog, the “Debug mode” switch and a “no access” screen. Errors are now in plain words, without technical details. The old page stays at /legacy/admin.html, and admin.html redirects to the new one. No migrations.

Achievements: the “Achievements” menu item now shows a red dot after you earn a new achievement — it stays even if you dismiss the congratulation and disappears once you open the Achievements page. Works on every page. No migrations.
Workouts: set rows are more compact on phones — reps, weight and time fit on one line, and Left/Right pairs no longer grow three times taller

Goals: a new “This week” horizon (between “Soon” and “This month”) with its own section in the “By time” view; it is also in the “New goal” window on the home page. On the home page the Plans list is now “Goals for this week and month” and pulls in goals of both horizons that are not in the plan yet. Needs migration 086; without it the form offers “This week” but will not save it and tells you the migration is needed.

Home, Plans: the “New goal” window has a “Goal type” — “Lose weight” or “Gain weight” (as in Goals): the starting weight is filled in from your latest measurement, enter the target. A weight goal is created in Goals and added to the day plan right away. The type picker appears once migration 085 is applied; without it the window works as before.

Achievements: the “new achievement” congratulation now arrives almost right after any save on any page (Goals, Workouts, Skills, etc.), not only after Dashboard actions: the header notices a successful write and starts the check about 5 seconds later (at most once per 30 seconds). No migrations.

Vintage Paper theme: borders no longer cut into letters. Buttons with no inner padding (the "Currently selected" rows in Customization, the points counter by the profile) got the theme's outline ring drawn right against the text, so the first and last letters sat under the line. Such buttons no longer get the ring. No migrations.

Achievements: the “new achievement” congratulation now arrives almost right after an action on the page (about 5 seconds after data is saved, at most once per 30 seconds) instead of only on the 1.5–10 minute timer. No migrations.

Plans on the home page: on today, a new “Goals for this month” list appears under the table — active goals with the “This month” horizon that are not in the plan yet. A single-step goal can be ticked right there (the tick is saved on the goal itself and it moves to “completed today”); a multi-stage goal shows its stage count. The “New goal” window on the home page now has the “When” field, like in Goals. The list appears only once migration 084 is applied.
Charts: the 7-day mini chart now also appears in “Sets” metric cards (reps per day) — under the same “Mini charts” option in Customization → Charts → Extras (off by default). No migrations.

Language learning: a "Review" card above the word list — the word is shown big, tap the card to see the translation and the example, "Learned" marks the word as learned, "Next" goes to the next one in a loop. It follows the selected language tab and shows only words that are not learned yet

Challenges: a feed of completed challenges — every completed challenge gets a card with its result ("days done X of N" or "collected X of N") and the date, newest first; above the feed you see how many are completed and how many are left to the next achievement

Charts: 7-day mini charts in the number-metric plates of Daily metrics — a tiny line under the value (days without data break the line). Turn them on in Customization → Charts → Extras (off by default, the page looks the same); screen-reader label and a row in “Selected now” included. No migrations.

Workouts, Progress tab: a "Weekly streak" block — how many weeks in a row (Mon–Sun) had at least one workout, the best streak, training days this week and the last 8 weeks as bars. An empty current week does not break the streak until it ends

Goals: weight goals. The goal form has a new “Goal type”: “Lose weight” or “Gain weight” — enter the starting and target weight (the start defaults to your latest weight). The card shows how far along you are, “N kg left” and a “Current weight” field with a “Log weight” button: the weight is also saved to today’s body stats, and changes made there show up in the goal right away. Reaching the target closes the goal by itself and awards its points; moving the weight back reopens it. Needs migration 085 (until then the type picker is hidden). Regular goals are unchanged.

Workouts, Progress tab: a new "What is growing" block shows for every exercise whether it is growing, flat or slipping: the best set of the last 28 days is compared with the previous 28 (change in percent and "was → now"). New exercises are marked "new"

Vintage Paper theme: the collapsible "Which achievements you can get here" block at the bottom of pages no longer has a double jagged dashed border — the theme's outline ring no longer lands on the borderless header button. The other pages in this theme were checked in Chromium (phone and desktop): no clipped text found. No migrations.

Customization: the “Selected now” summary has a new “Chart line” row — chart kind (line or bars), line style and enabled extras (draws itself, forecast, goal zone) at a glance; tap it to jump to the Charts section. No migrations.
Workouts: progressions and the overall chart moved to their own "Progress" tab, so the Exercises tab keeps only the programme, the warm-up and the exercises themselves

Dashboard: a number metric linked to a Workouts exercise now takes a set right in Daily metrics — a “Reps” field and a “+ set” button; the day total is recalculated from all sets of the exercise. Linked metrics (number and sets) also show a “from Workouts” label next to the name. No migrations.

Goals: each goal now has a horizon — Now, Soon, This month or On a specific day (pick a date). A new “By category / By time” switch above the list groups goals into horizon sections; your choice is remembered on this device. Until migration 084 is applied, the form offers only Now and On a specific day. Migration 084 is needed for the two new horizons.

Workouts: the sets of today's entry are now rows, like on the main page. Every set has its own row (time, reps, weight, duration), values are edited right in the row and saved at once, "+ set" adds a new row (a copy of the last one), and the cross removes any row. The "− set" button is gone: the cross on a row replaces it

Workouts: adding a new exercise no longer asks extra questions — only the name, typical exercise, variation and Save are visible; category, weight and unit, what to count, duration, left/right and muscles are tucked under “More” (defaults are already filled in). Editing an exercise shows everything, as before. No migrations.

Executive Glass theme: the right panel (gauges and water glass) no longer breaks — it used to shrink to the height of the top bar and stop working. The sticky top bar no longer gets the background blur. No migrations.

Customization: a new "Selected now" block at the top shows what is on in every section (theme, frame, loading screen, water, body model and more) and how many are not the default; tap a row to jump to its section. The group tabs now show owned/total counters, and the tab bar stays under the header while you scroll

The first themed big theme, Summer Meadow: a light milky background with a greenish undertone and a warm sun spot in the corner, a grass-green accent, rounded shapes, light greenish shadows on cards and smooth animations. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone. The Simple look switch removes the sun spot and the shadows

Charts: goal zone. If a metric has a goal, you can turn on a soft green band on the "good" side of the goal line: for "at least X" above the goal, for "less than X" below it. It works for lines and bars; body parameters (no goal direction) get no band. The "Charts" section in "Customization" is also shorter: the three on/off settings (line animation, forecast, goal zone) are now one "Extras" list instead of three card groups. Everything is off by default. No migrations.

Day plan: items you added yourself can now be edited (pencil: title, reminder time, completion time), and ticking an item as done on today's plan stamps the completion time next to it; untick to clear it.

Milestones: the selected category tab (for example "All · 3") shows its text again — it used to blend into the orange background and look empty. Milestone names are no longer squeezed by the buttons on the right: action buttons are more compact, the name takes the free space and rows have vertical padding. No migrations.

Customization: the «Owned / For achievements / For coins» filters now also govern the free sections (chart markers, splash, streak flame, water animation, body model): they count as «Owned» and hide with it. Before, with the filters off the page stayed full while also saying there was nothing to show. NO SQL.

Muscle map: instead of merely stretched body models there are now three with different proportions — Chibi (huge head, short legs), Long legs (small head) and Stocky. Pick them in Customization, Body model section, and in Workouts. The former Athletic, Slim and Curvy are gone; if you had picked one, the figure goes back to following your profile gender.
Customization: the Rainbow ring and Gradient ring items now have distinct previews (the rainbow used to show the plain gradient), and the “+” marker of the folding look is tidier.
Customization: a new week-gauge look — Wave (seven bars forming an arch, 150 points). Shown in the header and on the Dashboard.

New «Goal streaks» achievements: 3, 7, 14 and 30 days in a row with at least one goal completed (counted like the plate on the Goals page). The badges show in Achievements and on profiles in Community. Rewards for them come later. NO SQL (uses migration 079).
Customization: two new water-glass shapes — Tumbler (100 points) and Jar (150 points). They change the glass in the header and on the Dashboard.

Headings: there is now always a gap between an icon and its text (icons used to sit flush against it — in headings, "quick ideas" chips and elsewhere), and page and section headings (Achievements, Customization, Shop, Goals, Skills, Workouts and others) got SVG icons where they were missing.
Small buttons are easier to tap on phones: «Another» and «＋» (add dictionary) in Languages, the rarity filter chips in Achievements. NO SQL.
Customization: two new day-ring looks — Thick ring (100 points) and Rainbow ring (250 points). The ring changes in the header and on the Dashboard.

All links to the old (classic) version of the pages are gone: the «legacy-…» link at the bottom of the side menu on every page and the unobtrusive links on the sign-in and onboarding pages. Old bookmarks keep working — the redirects to the new pages are still in place. NO SQL.
Customization: two new block-folding looks — Plus / minus and Triangle (100 points each). They only change the marker next to block titles on the Dashboard and in Workouts.

Sign-in and sign-up: the Log in / Sign up switch is now real segmented buttons; the empty password field shows dots (so it is clear it is an input); a length hint sits under the password when signing up; an error or "check your email" shows right above the button instead of small grey text at the bottom; language and theme buttons are bigger for fingers. Password managers now offer a new password on sign-up. No migrations.

The fifth light big theme, Executive Glass: a light gray background with soft colored light spots, translucent frosted-glass cards and windows that blur what is behind them, an indigo accent, graphite text and a gentle lift of buttons on hover. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone. If the browser cannot blur, you get ordinary cards. The glass is switched off by the Simple look switch and by the system high-contrast and reduce-transparency settings. The theme description also gained the labels Frosted-glass panels and Colored light spots on the background

Skills and books: layout polished. In a skill card the name now takes the full width (no longer squeezed by the points pill and buttons), the progress bar spans the whole card, points moved to the bottom row next to the -10% / +10% buttons, and edit / delete sit in the card corner. In the Mastered skills and Books lists the name takes the free space while points and buttons are aligned to the right edge and the row center. No migrations.

Charts: bars. In "Customization", the "Charts" section, a new "Chart type" choice: "Line" (default, as before) or "Bars" — one bar per day with data, growing from zero, with a rounded top. For metrics with set variations the bar is stacked: segments in the legend colours. The goal line is drawn over the bars; the tooltip, keyboard and appearance animation work, there is no forecast in bars. No migrations.

Phone page check: the «i» («About this page») icon is easier to tap (a wider tap area, same look) and the «Got it» button in the page hint is taller. All pages were run through an automatic check: no horizontal scrolling, errors or blank pages anywhere; report in docs/FRONTEND_AUDIT.md. NO SQL.
Loading screen: two new free variants — Equalizer (five bouncing bars) and Pulse (rings spreading in waves). Pick them in Customization, Loading section; the colour follows the theme accent.

Goals: a new «Goals streak» shows how many days in a row you complete at least one goal (and your best streak). A day without a completed goal breaks it, today does not break it until the day is over, and pause days (vacation/illness) do not break it. No sparks or points are awarded for it yet. SQL REQUIRED: migration 079 (the line is absent until then).
Customization shop: two new paid water animations — Sway (the glass rocks while the water rises; 150 coins) and Glow (the glass flares with a soft glow; 250 coins).
Languages and Challenges: the progress ring (percent in the middle) no longer has a black rectangular frame around it — it was drawn by an accidentally matching class name. No migrations.

Settings across devices, part 2: besides theme and language, layout and view now follow you to another device — collapsed blocks on the Dashboard, Goals and Skills, chart periods, tabs and filters (Workouts, Community, Customization, Shop, Languages), favorite pages, weight unit and body model. On a new device the page reloads once to pick them up. One-off "dismissed hint" flags stay on the device. No new migrations (needs 064).

New light big theme Vintage Paper: a parchment-ivory background, an ink-blue accent with terracotta for warnings, thin dashed borders, strict outlined buttons without a fill, serif headings (classic typography) and sharp corners. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone. The theme description also gained the labels Serif headings and Outlined buttons without a fill

Community: a friend's profile window now has a collapsed «Wish list · N» — what the friend is saving up for in the shop (not yet bought, cheapest first): name with a link, picture and price. View only; gifts and transfers happen outside the app. People hidden from the community are not shown. SQL REQUIRED: migration 077 (the section is absent until then).

Customization shop: two new week-progress gauges — Seven dots (around a circle, Monday on top) and Steps (a staircase of seven bars). They work in the header, the side panel and the dashboard; prices 100 and 150 coins.

Customization: a new Body model section (Look tab) — pick the figure for the muscle map: By profile gender, Male, Female, Athletic, Slim, Curvy, each with a preview. The choice is shared with Workouts and the header mini-map.
Muscle map: three new body models — Athletic, Slim and Curvy. The switch in Workouts now offers five models (with Male and Female); the choice is remembered and shown in the header mini-map.

Customization: instead of 13 tabs in a row there are now five task-based groups: «Look» (themes, frames), «Home & progress» (day and week gauges, streak flame, block collapsing), «Water» (animations and glass shape), «Charts», «Loading». Inside a group everything is as before; «All» shows everything at once. Your picks and purchases are untouched. NO SQL.
Dashboard: one type scale — section and sub-section headings share size and weight (Streaks used to be bolder, chart titles had no set size).

Shop: adding a NEW purchase now asks «How big is this purchase?» with examples — small treat (coffee), small (dinner at a café), notable (sneakers), big (concert ticket), very big (a holiday). Your pick fills in a «fair» price based on your average daily earnings; you can still edit the price. NO SQL.

Charts: forecast. In "Customization", the "Charts" section, a new "Forecast" choice: "No forecast" (default) or "Trend for 3 days" — the chart continues as a dotted line three days ahead along the recent trend, with an empty dot and a "forecast ..." label (reps never go below zero). It is not a promise, just where the trend leads; shown when there are at least 4 days with data and the last one is recent. No migrations.

New light big theme Cyberpunk Day: a silver background with a micro dot grid, white cards with a dark frame and hard offset shadows, an ultramarine accent, monospace headings, labels and buttons, sharp corners and snappy animations. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone. The Simple look switch removes the grid. The theme description also gained the labels Hard offset shadows and Monospace font in headings, labels and buttons

The «Plans» block on the Dashboard is simpler: the main row has just the field and «Add», the three ways to add («Add from goals», «New goal», «Unfinished from earlier days») sit in a separate row of buttons below; time, «Already done», the ☆ bonus hint and notifications are tucked into a collapsed «More options»; «Goals completed that day» is collapsed to one line. Nothing was removed. NO SQL.

Goals: card layout polished. Titles now start at the same indent for goals with a percent ring and simple goals with a circle; points moved into the chips row (difficulty, deadline, points) so a long name takes up to three lines instead of four; the edit and delete buttons in the card corner no longer take width from the chips and progress bar; chips no longer slide under the buttons for short names. No migrations.

Dashboard: the Save day button is now large and modern with the day score as a pill beside it; the What you got done today panel has a backing card; an even gap between icon and text; the empty hole between the last block and the achievements block is gone.

Achievements: for a new account (first 14 days) the "new achievement" notification now arrives quickly — the check on any page runs about every 1.5 minutes instead of every 10. Before, the first actions (added a goal, moved to another page) stayed without a notification until the person opened Achievements themselves. Other accounts are unchanged. No migrations.

Workouts → Muscle map → a new collapsed «Body measurements» block: optionally log circumferences (neck, shoulders, chest, waist, hips, biceps, forearms, thighs and calves, left and right) in centimetres with a date. It shows the latest value and the change from the previous one; tap a part for its history with a mini chart and delete. SQL REQUIRED: migration 074 (the block is hidden until then).

Log in / Sign up: input fields now look like fields — a clearly visible border (light and dark themes), a focus highlight and an example hint in the email field; taller fields (46 px), bigger Log in / Sign up and Continue with Google buttons (48 px), easier-to-tap tabs and a large tap area for the password eye; 16 px text in the fields so phones do not zoom the page while typing. Nothing overflows on narrow screens (checked down to 320 px). No migrations.
Workouts: spacing evened out — one rhythm inside the exercise card (header, hints, record, chart, entries list); the Male / Female switch now sits on the left like the other controls.

Muscle map: the female body model is now truly feminine — a slim waist, wide hips, narrow shoulders, arms held away from the torso so the waist shows. Customization: water animation examples now play right in the tiles, like the streak flame — the Show buttons are gone.

New light big theme Matcha Latte: a warm cream background, a matcha-green accent, large corners and soft fluffy shadows, as if the cards float above paper. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone. The Simple look switch removes the shadows

Workouts → muscle map → «Suggested exercises»: for women «Shrugs» now sit at the end of the list with a soft note «usually not needed for women» (they used to be suggested like the rest). It is only a hint: you can still log any exercise. The gender comes from your profile; if it is not set, nothing changes. NO SQL.

New Customization category «Water glass shape»: mug (100), bottle (150), flask (150) and goblet (250) replace the plain glass in the water badge in the header and on the Dashboard; the water fills that very shape. The plain glass stays free. SQL REQUIRED: migration 073 (prices; until then buying answers «unknown item»).

The "Three tongues" flame is now slower and smoother (on the loading splash, in the Customization preview and in the streak flame). The streak flame still speeds up with the tier: the longer the streak, the livelier the flame.

The first light big theme, Paper Alpine: a cool milky-white background, clean white cards without shadows, small corners, a calm arctic-blue accent and smooth animations. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone. Also, in the theme description (What this theme changes) flat themes are now honestly labeled Flat cards without shadows, and the matte grain is labeled Matte grain on the background

Muscle map: the female body model is now noticeably more feminine — narrow shoulders, a slim waist, wider hips, a slimmer neck and arms. Customization: every water animation now has a live example — a small glass replaying the animation, both in the section tiles and on the paid item cards.

Customization, "Water animation": every variant now has its own "Show" button that plays exactly that animation (the glass fills in the middle of the screen) without changing your choice. It works for "By theme" (shows the current theme animation), the six free variants and the paid ones (rain, tide, sparkle) — so you can preview before buying. No migrations.
Fixes after a visual check: the female body model's arms no longer bend outward at the hands, and the sparkles in the water animation are now gold — the white ones were invisible on light themes.
New users no longer see the weekend «Weekly summary is coming» banner: there is nothing to sum up in the first week after sign-up. Everyone else sees it as before. NO SQL.

New page loader "Orbit": a softly pulsing core, two rings and dots running around them in opposite directions (the color follows the theme accent). Pick it in Customization in the loader section, or preview it by opening any page with ?splash=orbit. It is the fifth variant (next to Living flame, Three tongues, Fire ring and Classic), free for now; with reduce-motion and Disable animations the dots do not spin. No migrations.

Workouts → muscle map: clicking a row of the "when each muscle was last worked" list (or a muscle under "Not trained yet") opens that muscle's panel; rows work with the keyboard. The panel now has a "Sets per week" graph for 8 weeks (the current week is highlighted) and a text summary for screen readers. No migrations.

Charts: accessibility. Every chart now has a text summary ("minimum, maximum, latest") and a "date — value" table for screen readers; they are not visible on screen and the chart looks the same. No migrations.

Customization, «Day progress gauge»: two new day ring looks. «Dial» (150 coins) — a thin ring with twelve clock marks that light up as the day fills; «Gradient ring» (250 coins) — an arc fading from your accent colour to gold (an avatar frame keeps its own colours). Shown around the avatar in the Dashboard and in the day badge in the header. Needs migration 071 (owner applies).

Global settings, Effects: a new Simple look switch. It turns off the glow, grids, scanlines, grain and soft shadows of the big themes (the colors stay), regardless of the system settings. It applies at once, is remembered and works on every page

The page loader now comes with the big theme: Emerald Obsidian — "Fire ring", Moonlight Synth — "Three tongues", Matrix Phosphor — "Classic", Tokyo Nightfall — "Living flame". The loader section in Customization has a new "By theme" tile (selected by default) that shows which loader is playing now. A loader picked by hand (or a page opened with ?splash=) always wins over the theme; regular themes keep the "Living flame". No migrations.

Community: friends now show "online" or "was online N ago" on their card and in their profile window. You can turn it off in Settings → Privacy; only your friends can see it. It starts working once server migration 069 is applied.

Workouts: "+ set" right in the add-entry row. Pressing Add again on the same day now appends a set to today's entry of that exercise instead of creating a second entry for the same date (as it did before). The row stays open, remembers the previous set's values, shows "Today: N sets", and the button becomes "+ set". Close with ✕ or Esc. No migrations.

Customization: three paid drink-saved animations — Rain (100), Tide (150) and Sparkles (250). The equipped one plays when you log water in the header and on the Dashboard and overrides the free choice. Needs migration 072 (catalog prices).

Charts: appearance animation. In "Customization", in the "Charts" section, a new "Appearance" choice: "No animation" (default) or "Line draws itself" — when the page opens the line is drawn left to right, then the dots and labels fade in. With the system "reduce motion" or the site animations turned off the chart stays still. Free. No migrations.

New big theme Nord Frost - the sixth and last of the first series of big themes: cold slate blue, flat cards without shadows, small corners, a barely visible matte grain on the background, high text contrast and a clear red for warnings. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone. With the system high-contrast setting on, the grain switches off by itself

Drink-saved animation: three new variants — Bubbles, Pour and Splash (six in total, all free). Customization has a new Water animation tab: pick a variant or By theme, and it plays right after you choose. The choice is shared with the header Settings.

New «Pause: vacation / illness» mode (Global settings → «Pause»). Pick «Vacation» or «Illness» and the last day of the pause — up to 30 days, starting today (it cannot be backdated). For those days streaks and weekly progress freeze: a streak does not break and does not grow, and metrics are not counted as missed. A pause icon appears in the header (tap it for the settings); you can end the pause early in the same settings. Needs migration 070 (owner applies); without it the section is simply hidden.

Charts: line styles. In "Customization" the "Chart markers" section is now "Charts": besides markers you can pick the line — "Classic (straight)" as before, "Smooth" and "Smooth with area" (a soft gradient fill under the line). The smooth curve never goes above or below your real values, and gaps are still dashed. Free; charts pick your choice up the next time the page opens. No migrations.

New big theme Velvet Dusk: a cozy dark slate background with peach, pink and teal, large 12-16 px corners, smooth springy animations and not a drop of neon glow. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone

Customization: the page is split into tabs — Themes, Chart markers, Loading screen, Streak flame, Avatar frames, Gauges and the other sections; one section is shown at a time. The last tab, All, brings back the old long list. The chosen tab is remembered.

Workouts: "Log entry" without a window now also works on the Muscle map tab (the "Your exercises" block) and in the progression trees — a row unfolds right under the exercise or step. "Details…" opens the old window; exercises with left/right sides still use the window. No migrations.

Achievements: the congratulation now shows on ANY page. When you earn a new achievement (e.g. finish your first goal), a «New achievement — well done!» card with its name, reward and a «See it» button appears at the bottom of the screen; several at once come as one list. Before, you only learned about a new achievement by opening the Achievements page. The check runs quietly in the background when a page opens and then every 10 minutes; the same achievement is never congratulated twice. NO SQL.

Water animation: every "big theme" now brings its own "saved" animation (Emerald Obsidian and Matrix Phosphor — expanding ripples, Moonlight Synth — bouncy drops, Tokyo Nightfall — a calm wave). The header Settings has a new "By theme" option (selected by default): the current theme's animation plays, on regular themes the calm wave. A variant picked by hand always wins over the theme. No migrations.
Fixed: after applying a theme in Customization, the theme picker in the left menu now shows the new theme right away instead of keeping the old entry.
Fixed: the “Achievements you can earn here” block at the bottom of a page no longer overlaps the page content (chart labels) — it now sits right below it.

Charts: a point tooltip. Hover a chart with the mouse, touch it, or use the arrow keys — a dashed crosshair, a ring around the point and a tag with the date and value appear (for metrics with set variations, also the breakdown). Escape hides it. The chart itself looks as before. No migrations.

Customization: new «Day progress gauge» section — the day ring look is now chosen there too. The smooth ring is free and default, «Dashed ring» (20 dashes lighting up one by one) costs 100 coins, «Glowing ring» 150. The chosen look is shown by the ring around the avatar in the Dashboard and by the day badge in the header on every page (an avatar frame with its own glow keeps its glow). Needs migration 068 (owner applies).

Muscle map: a female body model (same muscles, female proportions). The Muscle map tab has a Male / Female switch, defaulting to the gender from your profile. The model also shows on the mini-map in the right panel. In sign-up, gender is now a required choice with no default.

Customization: a new "Streak flame" section — two free looks for the flame next to your streak on the Dashboard: "Single flame" (as now) and "Three tongues" (the earlier flame with sparks). The choice shows on the Dashboard from the next load.

Customization: new «Week gauge» section — the week look is now chosen there instead of Progress settings. Heptagon by days is free and default, «Classic ring» costs 100 coins, «Seven bars» 150. The same look is shown everywhere: header, Dashboard profile and the home page (fixes the bug where the home page showed the old week gauge and other pages the new one). Needs migration 067 (owner applies).

Customization: every "big theme" card (Emerald Obsidian, Moonlight Synth, Matrix Phosphor, Tokyo Nightfall) now has a short "What this theme changes" list: own colors, corners (sharp/soft), dashed borders, monospace font, neon glow or soft shadows and an active-element outline, dot-grid background, scanlines, animation speed. The list is generated from the same data the theme is built from, so it cannot drift from the theme. Regular themes have no list. No migrations.

Charts: the little pie-chart dots on metrics with sets can now look different. "Customization" has a new "Chart markers" section with four free styles and a live preview: "Flat (classic)" — the default, "Glass", "Drop" and "Outline". Charts pick your choice up the next time the page opens. No migrations.

New big theme Tokyo Nightfall: deep night blue, soft diffuse shadows on cards and windows, 8 px corners, a tidy lavender highlight on selected and pressed items and smooth animations. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone. With the system high-contrast setting on, the shadows are removed and the lavender outline of the selected item stays crisp

Admin: a "Debug mode" switch (administrator only, for yourself only) — the groundwork for a future "try on" of paid Customization items without paying. The mode itself changes nothing in the app yet; the "Try on" button comes in the next update. Server side: migration 066 (applied by the owner). Nothing changes for other users.
Workouts: the page now has two tabs, Exercises and Muscle map. The muscle map moved to the second tab (no header button of its own), and the chosen tab is remembered.

Calendar, Languages and Skills pages now have an "Add this page's widget to the home page" button at the top (next to the favorites heart): one tap puts the widget in the Widgets block on the Dashboard (calendar; all languages; skills — up to 12, unfinished first). If the widget is already on the home page, the button shows a check mark and removes it. Other widgets are untouched. No migrations.

New big theme Matrix Phosphor: black background, green terminal accent, sharp corners, monospace font across the interface, thin scanlines and snappy animations. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone. With the system high-contrast setting on, the scanlines switch off by themselves

Workouts: the Add exercise window has a new "Pick a typical exercise by body diagram" button. Green muscles were worked in the last 4 days, grey ones were not; tap the muscles you want (or "What I haven't trained") and choose an exercise — its name and fields are filled in for you.

Customization: a new "Loading screen" section — pick one of four variants with a live preview: "Living flame" (default), "Three tongues" (the old flame), "Fire ring" and "Classic". All are free; your choice is remembered and applies to every page of the site from the next load. No migrations.

New big theme Moonlight Synth: deep violet background with a dot grid, neon glow on active buttons and checkmarks, soft corners and springy animations. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone. With the system high-contrast setting on, the glow and grid switch off by themselves
In Workouts, exercise names now always start with a capital letter: both when saving a new one and when showing old ones (some used to be lower-case).

Fixed: on the main page (Dashboard) the week progress badge in the top bar was drawn as the old rounded square while other pages showed the by-day heptagon. Now every page uses the same look (heptagon; "classic" if chosen in settings). No migrations.

History: a "By category" block now sits above the month grid — a donut of metric categories for the selected month (one arc per category: length = its share of tracked days, fill = what was done) with a "done/total · %" legend. Metrics without a category form their own group; with a single category the block is hidden. No migrations.
Fixed: the whole list of goals disappeared on the Goals page when friend invitations were enabled. The list is now always shown, with invitations above it.

Security: a Customization purchase record can no longer be deleted or edited from the app to "get coins back" (migration 065; applied by the owner). Regular Shop wishes work as before. Nothing changes for you.

Loading screen: the old three-tongue flame with sparks is back as it used to be — now a separate "Three tongues" variant. Try it now: add ?splash=tongues to the address of any page (it is remembered); the picker in "Customization" comes next. The default is still the "Living flame". No migrations.
Languages: "Idiom of the day" now includes Italian and Portuguese, and the word counters became a card with a "learned N%" ring for the selected dictionary.

Icons: the 19 most dated icons were redrawn — run, walk, yoga, swim, stretch, boxing, jump rope, treadmill, skiing, bandage, broom, party popper, tree, snowflake, bird, fish, guitar, cake and lungs. Same stroke style with rounded ends, icon names unchanged, so metrics and goals keep their icons. No migrations.
Every category in Goals now shows a mini progress: a thin bar and "done/total" right in the section header.

The flame next to a metric with a streak in "Daily metrics": from 7 days in a row (when today is already counted) it is now the living flame, like the main streak, instead of a static icon. Emerald theme: the checkbox tick is now dark and readable on the light accent. No migrations.

The Goals page is tidier: every category is a collapsible section with a counter, "Upcoming deadlines" (overdue and due within 14 days) sits on top, and "Completed" and the section settings are collapsed by default. What you collapse is remembered.

New big theme Emerald Obsidian - not just colors but the whole look: sharp 2 px corners, dashed card borders, monospace headings and snappy animations. Pick it in Customization or the header settings; open to everyone

Milestones now has category tabs above the list (All · Health · Car …) with counters, and the "Templates" button opens a catalog of ready-made milestones: health (check-ups as rough guides — ask your doctor), car, home, documents. Pick one and the form opens pre-filled; just set when it was last done.

The muscle map is now always visible: on the Workouts page and in the right panel. While there are no exercises yet the map is empty (all muscles grey) with a hint: add your first exercise and log a workout and the muscles will light up. Before, the map only appeared after the first exercise, so a new person did not know it existed. No migrations.

Under the hood: groundwork for big appearance themes - corner radius, shadows, textures, borders and font can now be changed by a theme, not just colors. Nothing looks different yet: the defaults match the previous look of the site

Workouts: "Log entry" no longer opens a window — a row unfolds right in the exercise card (reps, weight or duration; time is filled in). "Details…" opens the old window (other date, several sets, a note); exercises with left/right sides still use the window. No migrations.

The streak flame in the "Streaks" window and on the home page is now the same ONE living flame as on the loading screen instead of three swaying tongues; in the "Streaks" window every streak of 7+ days burns animated and gets brighter, with sparks, at 30 and 100 days. Weekly streaks keep the plain flame. No migrations.

Achievements: if you just created your account and did things before first opening the Achievements section, you now see a congratulation with your reward on that first visit. Before, such achievements silently appeared in the list.

"Idiom of the day" is now in Languages: a proverb or set phrase (English, German, French, Spanish) with a translation and explanation. "Another" browses the collection and "Add to my words" puts the idiom into your dictionary.
Removed the "pilot on Vue" wording from the browser tab titles on every page (Goals, Workouts, Shop, etc.): these pages stopped being a pilot long ago. No migrations.

Look fix: the loader flame and the logo flame in the header are as wide as before again (they had become noticeably narrower and looked "squeezed"); the page hint card (the "i" strip under the top bar) is now centered on the page instead of hugging the right edge. The "i" icon stays on the right. No migrations.

Settings across devices: theme, language, the animations switch, favorite themes, streak celebrations, the "yesterday's unfinished" window, the water reminder, "Progress in the menu" and the day-ring settings are now saved to your account and pulled in on another device (a new device takes the account settings; what you change here goes to the account). Needs migration 064 (applied by the owner): until then everything works as before, on one device only.
The "i" button with the page hint is no longer in the top bar (it is busy enough) — it now sits in a thin strip at the top of the page, right under it.

Phones: on screens up to 640 px the interface is 12.5% more compact — fonts, spacing, buttons and cards shrink on every page so more fits (Goals first). Tablets and desktops are unchanged. The amount is a single number if it needs to be larger or smaller. No migrations.
The sign-in page now has a collapsible "About the project" block: what this is in a nutshell, a link to the author's resume and Telegram.

Loading screen and the top-left logo: instead of three separate tongues swaying left and right, there is now ONE living flame — a single outline that smoothly morphs between three shapes, with two depth layers (outer body and a bright core) and sparks rising above it.
